title: OAuth2 Token Revocation Race Condition
description: Concurrent token refresh requests cause inconsistent session termination in the Redis cache layer under high concurrency.
resolutionNote: Blocks API integration; forecast completion moves from 15 Oct to 19 Oct.

title: WebRTC Video Stream Latency Spike
description: Signaling handshake fails intermittently under simulated network packet loss above 8%.
resolutionNote: Delay in STUN/TURN server configuration pushes client testing from 18 Oct to 21 Oct.

title: Upstream Banking SDK Compatibility Failure
description: Vendor API v3 deprecates legacy HMAC authentication without backwards compatibility layer.
resolutionNote: Direct vendor dependency blockage; project placed on hold pending vendor firmware patch.

title: Dark Theme Contrast Ratio Non-Compliance
description: Subtle slate borders and tertiary labels fall below WCAG 2.1 AA 4.5:1 ratio on OLED displays.
resolutionNote: Design token adjustments delay UI acceptance review from 20 Oct to 22 Oct.

title: Kubernetes Ingress SSL Certificate Renewal Hook Failure
description: Let's Encrypt automated ACME challenge dns01 failed during staging cluster re-provisioning.
resolutionNote: Updated Cert-Manager CRD and validated wildcard domain certificate rotation.

title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion in Staging
description: HikariCP pool max connections saturated under bulk CSV user export load test.
resolutionNote: Query optimization and read-replica routing required before stress test sign-off; moves finish from 05 Nov to 08 Nov.

title: Apple App Store Review Guideline 5.1.1 Rejection Risk
description: Privacy policy link in mobile onboarding flow was pointing to obsolete staging domain.
resolutionNote: Updated metadata URLs and resubmitted binary build 104 without schedule slippage.

title: Payment Webhook Idempotency Key Duplicate Bug
description: Retried Stripe webhook events with matching idempotency keys triggered dual database writes in edge cases.
resolutionNote: Added distributed Redis locking on incoming event ID; reconciler testing extended by 2 days.
